ctx.x: Oh, yeah, the idea of the swing band, so to speak, was such a new concept.

I remember a night, we had all been getting on Johnny Bothwell because everytime it came to a part where he had a jazz solo, he would do what I used to refer to as chicken imitations. He had a way of doing buck-buck-ba-da; I swear that's what it sounded like. His upper glisses were more chicken like than musical and a lot of the guys felt the same way I did, but we had never verbalized it. But one night we sat down with John and said, hey John, why don't you relax and just play the easy nice jazz that we know…

we get into it and he starts blowing sixteen bars, the most tasty, beautiful, ringing jazz that you could possibly hear, and we were all looking at each other, yeah, Johnny's really into it, how beautiful.
